records.context: Frames from ``<movie>/<seq>/t*.tif``, full masks from the silver segmentation ``<movie>/<seq>_ST/SEG/man_seg*.tif`` relabelled by the tracking markers ``<movie>/<seq>_GT/TRA/man_track*.tif`` (:func:`track_masks_from_ctc`). records.context: The Cell Tracking Challenge publishes tracking ground truth as MARKERS -- a small blob inside each cell, labelled with its track id in every frame -- and full outlines separately (the silver ``ST/SEG`` masks, labelled per frame). Only one-to-one assignments are retained: the object contains exactly one marker ID and that ID overlaps no other segmented object. Unmarked, merged and split assignments are excluded rather than guessed.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.track_masks_from_ctc#1
records.source: The Cell Tracking Challenge publishes tracking ground truth as MARKERS -- a small blob inside each cell, labelled with its track id in every frame -- and full outlines separately (the silver ``ST/SEG`` masks, labelled per frame). Only one-to-one assignments are retained: the object contains exactly one marker ID and that ID overlaps no other segmented object. Unmarked, merged and split assignments are excluded rather than guessed.
records.translation: Cell Tracking Challenge는 추적 참조를 MARKERS로 제공합니다. 이는 각 세포 안의 작은 영역으로, 각 프레임에서 궤적 식별자로 라벨링됩니다. 전체 윤곽은 프레임별로 라벨링된 silver ``ST/SEG`` 마스크로 별도 제공됩니다. 일대일 할당만 유지합니다. 객체에는 정확히 하나의 마커 식별자가 있어야 하고, 해당 마커는 다른 분할 객체와 겹치면 안 됩니다. 마커가 없거나 병합 또는 분할된 할당은 추측하지 않고 제외합니다.

records.context: A two-stage curriculum: the backbone's segmentation is already paid for, so it is frozen while the new head learns, then everything is trained at a low learning rate. Every pair is augmented identically on both frames before its targets are computed.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.train_timeflows#1
records.source: A two-stage curriculum: the backbone's segmentation is already paid for, so it is frozen while the new head learns, then everything is trained at a low learning rate. Every pair is augmented identically on both frames before its targets are computed.
records.translation: 두 단계로 학습합니다. 백본의 분할은 이미 학습되어 있으므로 새 헤드가 학습하는 동안 백본을 동결하고, 이후 낮은 학습률로 전체를 학습합니다. 각 쌍의 두 프레임에 동일한 데이터 증강을 적용한 뒤 목표값을 계산합니다.

records.context: A training extracted image region keeps supervision only for complete source masks and, when present in the full target frame, complete successor masks. A successor outside the tile is not a disappearance. Absences in the supplied full-frame labels remain supervised; this does not validate those annotations. Unusable extracted image regions are retried up to 32 times per step. Censoring prevents incorrect targets at extracted image region boundaries but removes some fast-motion examples; it does not establish full-motion accuracy.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.train_timeflows#2
records.source: A training crop keeps supervision only for complete source masks and, when present in the full target frame, complete successor masks. A successor outside the tile is not a disappearance. Absences in the supplied full-frame labels remain supervised; this does not validate those annotations. Unusable crops are retried up to 32 times per step. Censoring prevents incorrect targets at crop boundaries but removes some fast-motion examples; it does not establish full-motion accuracy.
records.translation: 학습용 잘라내기는 온전한 원본 마스크에 대해서만 감독 신호를 유지하며, 후속 객체가 전체 대상 프레임에 있으면 그 마스크도 온전해야 합니다. 타일 밖에 있는 후속 객체는 소실된 것이 아닙니다. 제공된 전체 프레임 라벨에서의 부재는 계속 감독 신호로 사용되지만, 이것이 주석의 정확성을 검증하지는 않습니다. 사용할 수 없는 잘라내기는 단계당 최대 32번 다시 시도합니다. 이러한 제외는 잘라내기 경계의 잘못된 목표값을 방지하지만 빠른 움직임의 일부 예제도 제거하므로 전체 움직임 범위의 정확성을 입증하지 않습니다.
